description: Rank telescopes by their share of all signals and return every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.

c.request: What are the top 10 telescopes by share of detected signals? For each telescope reference (`telescref`), show how many signals it detected and what fraction of all signals that is (unrounded), from the largest share down. Rank telescopes by their share of all signals and return every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.
c.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals FROM signals), shares AS (SELECT c.telescref, c.signal_count, c.signal_count * 1.0 / t.total_signals AS share FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t) SELECT telescref, signal_count, share FROM shares WHERE share >= (SELECT share FROM shares ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) ORDER BY share DESC;

a.request: For each telescope reference (`telescref`) in the signals table, count its signals and compute that count as an unrounded fraction of all signals. Show the telescope reference, the signal count and the fraction, sorted by fraction from highest to lowest, and return the top 10, including every telescope tied with the 10th one even if that gives more than 10 rows.
a.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM signals), ranked AS (SELECT c.telescref, c.signal_count, CAST(c.signal_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.n AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(c.signal_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.n DESC) AS rnk FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref;

b.request: Return each telescref with its signal count and unrounded share of all signals, ordered by share descending, including every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share (ties at the cutoff included)
b.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), shares AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, 1.0 * signal_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS share FROM counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, share FROM shares WHERE share >= (SELECT share FROM shares ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) ORDER BY share DESC;

d.request: Which telescopes rank in the top 10 by share of all detected signals, showing each `telescref`, its signal count, and its unrounded fraction of all signals, and include every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including ties at the cut?
d.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals FROM signals), shares AS (SELECT c.telescref, c.signal_count, c.signal_count * 1.0 / t.total_signals AS share FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t), cutoff AS (SELECT share FROM shares ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT s.telescref, s.signal_count, s.share FROM shares s WHERE s.share >= COALESCE((SELECT share FROM cutoff), 0) ORDER BY s.share DESC
